summary.en: A picture assembles from shards that fly in from scattered 3D poses and click into place from the centre out; or it shatters and flies off the frame.
summary.zh: 一张画面切成 5×5 碎片，从三维散乱姿态按中心向外的波纹逐圈飞回原位、咔哒入槽；或整面碎开飞出画面。

fits: Chaos to form: the first shot of an opening revealing a poster or product picture; reversed (out), a hard exit from a held picture.
notFor: Pictures whose detail must be read while moving; light, flat styles with no depth; more than once a film.

overlaps.note: tiles grow in place from points (2D); shard-gather flies 3D shards in from scattered poses
a page's parts rise along its normal and return; shard-gather scatters a picture's grid of tiles in every axis

intent.en: Film 'the product takes shape' as a physical event: a whole picture grows out of disorder before the viewer's eyes; reversed, it clears the screen by flying apart, not fading.
intent.zh: 把“产品成形”拍成一件物理事件：观众看着一整面画面从无序中长出来；反着用时，画面是被炸飞出画，而不是淡掉。

content.en: One picture (a poster, a product picture or a title card) painted into a rect, split into 5 × 5 tiles; keep any logo inside one tile.
content.zh: 一张画面（海报、产品图或标题卡），画进一个矩形、切成 5 × 5 块；标志要整个落在一块里。

fits.zh: 从混沌到成形：开场第一镜揭示一张海报或产品图；反向（out）作为一张定格画面的硬退场。

notFor.zh: 运动中就要读清细节的画面；没有纵深的浅色平面风格；一支片用两次以上。

pairs.note: a claim landing on the assembled poster

en: Exit by flying out, not by fading; a fade reads as vanishing and the physics is lost.
Do not let a logo or key word straddle a tile seam; the seam cuts a hairline through it and reads as a broken picture.
In through, the hold is the only reading window; longer copy needs a longer hold before the shards leave.
zh: 退场靠位移飞出，不要淡出；淡出读作“消失”而非“飞走”，物理感尽失。
标志或关键字别跨拼缝；拼缝会切出一条细缝，读作坏图。
through 式里停顿段是唯一的读字窗口；文案更长要先拉长停顿再让碎片起飞。

upstream.name: 碎片聚合飞散
upstream.summary: 5×5 瓦片从 3D 碎片态按中心波纹逐圈聚合成整面海报，停一拍亮字，随后全部碎片背离中心加速旋转飞出画面
upstream.use: 开场第一镜"从混沌到成形"的品牌/海报揭示；倒放或只取后半可作硬转场
upstream.energy: 高（两头高能、中段静止，适合压 BGM 重音起收）
